title: cckit integration descriptor
description: One optional third-party tool cckit can offer, install and verify. One file per tool: integrations/<id>.json. Checked by integration_validate (scripts/lib/integrations.sh), which implements exactly these keywords: type, required, properties, additionalProperties:false, items, minItems, minLength, pattern, enum. A keyword outside that list is NOT enforced — extend the validator before using one here.

id.description: The handle typed after `cckit add`. Must equal the file name without `.json`.

label.description: Human name shown in lists and prompts.

summary.description: One line: what the tool does for the project.

why.description: Optional: what it costs and what it replaces.

config.description: The project-config key that turns the integration on. Naming rule: the key names a CAPABILITY, never the vendor — `<capability>.provider` whose value names the tool (the `deploy.target` / `ci.provider` precedent in modules/software.json), or `<capability>.enabled` for a boolean switch that already exists (`memory.enabled`, `local.enabled`). A key containing the descriptor's own id is refused. Every key used here needs a property in kit.config.schema.json.

key.description: Dotted path into the project config, e.g. `codeGraph.provider`.

value.description: The value at `key` that means ON. Omitted = boolean true.

appliesWhen.description: Which repos the tool can work on. Omitted = any repo. An integration that does not apply is not offered.

anyExtension.description: Applies when at least one file in the repo ends in one of these extensions. Case-sensitive, leading dot. The repo's files are git's tracked + unignored list inside a work tree, otherwise every file outside .git/ and node_modules/.

note.description: Where the list was verified, and what happens to a file outside it.

detect.description: How to tell the tool is already installed.

run.description: Command that exits 0 when the tool is present.

install.description: Install candidates, tried IN THIS ORDER; the first that works wins.

manager.description: The tool that must be on the machine for this candidate to be tried.

resident.description: false when the candidate leaves no binary behind (npx). Default true.

wire.description: Optional per-repo step after install, for a tool that writes into the project.

run.description: The wire command, without the declined flags.

dryRun.description: A form of the command that prints what it would write.

writes.description: Paths the wire step creates or edits.

declined.description: Flags cckit passes to turn a tool feature OFF, each mapped to the reason. Keys are the flags, values the reasons.

build.description: Optional step that produces the tool's own data (an index, a graph).

cost.description: What the step spends: time, network, API calls.

deep.description: A costlier variant of the build. cckit runs it only when `auto` is true.

auto.description: Default false: recorded for the user, never run by cckit.

verify.description: How to tell the installed tool works.

run.description: Command that exits 0 when the tool is healthy.

json.description: A form of the command with machine-readable output.

uninstall.description: Optional command that removes what install + wire added.

recheck.description: Optional: what the scheduled recipe check should watch.

drifts.description: The parts of the recipe that go stale: package names, flag names, lists.

attribution.description: Credit for a tool cckit did not write. Held as fields so the next integration cannot ship without them.

affiliated.description: false when cckit has no relationship with the author.

notice.description: The sentence shown to the user: who makes the tool and whether cckit is affiliated.

telemetry.description: What the tool reports home, and what cckit does about it.
